SONAR.gloss: a measuring instrument that sends out an acoustic pulse in water and measures…
SONAR.definition: A measuring instrument that sends out an acoustic pulse in water and measures distances in terms of the time for the echo of the pulse to return.
SONAR.example: Sonar is an acronym for sound navigation ranging.
